blocks.zh: Section 2: Validation & Routine Process Control | 驗證與常規製程控制
blocks.en: Section 2: Validation & Routine Process Control

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives for This Section

blocks.zh: 理解設備確效 (Equipment Qualification, EQ) 的架構，包括 IQ、OQ 及其在乾熱去熱原中的應用。
blocks.en: Understand the framework of equipment qualification (EQ), including IQ and OQ and their application in dry heat depyrogenation.

blocks.zh: 掌握空烘箱/隧道溫度分佈研究、元件映射 (Component Mapping) 和負載映射 (Load Mapping) 的要求與差異。
blocks.en: Master the requirements for, and differences among, empty oven/tunnel temperature distribution studies, component mapping and load mapping.

blocks.zh: 了解去熱原確認研究 (Confirmation of Depyrogenation) 的設計，包括樣品數量、取樣位置及可接受標準 (NMT 0.1 EU)。
blocks.en: Understand the design of the confirmation of depyrogenation study, including number of samples, sampling locations and the acceptance criterion (NMT 0.1 EU).

blocks.zh: 掌握常規製程控制 (Routine Process Control) 的要素，包括校準、定期內毒素評估和持續驗證狀態維護。
blocks.en: Master the elements of routine process control, including calibration, periodic endotoxin assessment and maintenance of the validated state.

blocks.zh: Validation 驗證
blocks.en: Validation

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 設備確效 (EQ) 架構
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Equipment Qualification (EQ) Framework

blocks.zh: 乾熱去熱原設備確效通常分為以下階段：
blocks.en: Equipment qualification for dry heat depyrogenation is usually divided into the following stages:

blocks.zh: IQ（安裝確效）：確認設備按設計規格安裝，文件記錄完整（型號、序號、公用設施連接、校準狀態）
blocks.en: IQ (installation qualification): confirm that the equipment is installed according to design specifications and that documentation is complete (model, serial number, utility connections, calibration status)

blocks.zh: OQ（運作確效）：確認設備在空載條件下按預期運作（溫控系統功能、警報響應、HEPA 完整性）
blocks.en: OQ (operational qualification): confirm that the equipment operates as intended under empty conditions (temperature control system function, alarm response, HEPA integrity)

blocks.zh: PQ（效能確效）：在實際生產條件下（含負載）確認設備能一致達到去熱原效果
blocks.en: PQ (performance qualification): confirm under actual production conditions (with load) that the equipment consistently achieves depyrogenation

blocks.zh: EQ 為後續的預防性維護計畫和變更管控建立基準，是維持「驗證狀態」的根基。
blocks.en: EQ establishes the baseline for the subsequent preventive maintenance program and change control, and is the foundation for maintaining the "validated state".

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — EQ 就像新車交車檢查
blocks.en: Analogy: EQ Is Like a New Car Delivery Inspection

blocks.zh: 設備確效就像買新車的「交車檢查」流程：
blocks.en: Equipment qualification is like the delivery inspection when you buy a new car:

blocks.zh: IQ = 確認車輛規格與訂單相符（引擎排氣量、配備清單、VIN 碼）
blocks.en: IQ = confirm that the vehicle specifications match the order (engine displacement, equipment list, VIN)

blocks.zh: OQ = 在停車場測試所有功能（冷氣、喇叭、雨刷、車窗）
blocks.en: OQ = test all functions in the parking lot (air conditioning, horn, wipers, windows)

blocks.zh: PQ = 實際上路行駛，確認在各種路況下均達到預期效能
blocks.en: PQ = actually drive on the road and confirm the expected performance under various road conditions

blocks.zh: EQ 為維護保養（如定期換油 = 定期校準）和重大改裝（變更管控）建立基準。
blocks.en: EQ establishes the baseline for maintenance (such as regular oil changes = periodic calibration) and major modifications (change control).

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 驗證前就要了解內毒素來源
blocks.en: Key Point: Understand Endotoxin Sources Before Validation

blocks.zh: USP 特別強調：對去熱原製程的關注（包括了解來料內毒素殘留量），應在藥品開發階段就開始，而非等到驗證才處理。這是「製程理解先於驗證」的現代 GMP 思維，與 ICH Q8 的「設計空間」概念一致。
blocks.en: USP specifically emphasizes that attention to the depyrogenation process (including understanding the endotoxin level on incoming items) should begin in the drug development phase rather than waiting until validation. This is the modern GMP mindset of "process understanding before validation" and is consistent with the "design space" concept of ICH Q8.

blocks.zh: 若開發期間就建立清楚的內毒素輸入/輸出模型，驗證設計將更具科學依據，且更有機會採用「基於劑量學」的驗證策略。
blocks.en: If a clear endotoxin input/output model is established during development, the validation design will have a stronger scientific basis and a better chance of adopting a dosimetric validation strategy.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 某 CDMO 計劃引進一台新的乾熱去熱原烘箱，請列出 IQ 和 OQ 各應確認的主要項目各 3 項。
blocks.en: A CDMO plans to bring in a new dry heat depyrogenation oven. List three main items to be confirmed in IQ and three in OQ.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 EQ 文件對「變更管控」很重要？如果烘箱的加熱元件需要更換，EQ 基準如何協助評估影響？
blocks.en: Why are EQ documents important for change control? If the oven's heating element has to be replaced, how does the EQ baseline help assess the impact?

blocks.zh: Temperature Distribution & Component/Load Mapping 溫度分佈與元件/負載映射
blocks.en: Temperature Distribution & Component/Load Mapping

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 三層溫度研究架構
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Three-Tier Temperature Study Framework

blocks.zh: USP 設計了清晰的三層溫度研究架構：
blocks.en: USP sets out a clear three-tier framework for temperature studies:

blocks.zh: 空腔溫度分佈 (Empty Chamber)：了解設備本身的加熱均勻性（烘箱有意義，隧道價值有限）
blocks.en: Empty chamber temperature distribution: understand the heating uniformity of the equipment itself (meaningful for ovens, of limited value for tunnels)

blocks.zh: 元件映射 (Component Mapping)：確認熱穿透到複雜物品的最冷點（冷點定位）
blocks.en: Component mapping: confirm the coldest point to which heat penetrates in complex items (cold spot location)

blocks.zh: 負載映射 (Load Mapping)：在實際生產負載條件下，找出整個裝載中 FH 最低的位置
blocks.en: Load mapping: under actual production load conditions, find the location with the lowest FH in the entire load

blocks.zh: 這三層研究層層遞進，從設備到元件到生產條件，確保每個環節都受到充分理解。
blocks.en: These three tiers build on one another, from equipment to component to production conditions, ensuring that each link is fully understood.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 隧道空載研究的「有限價值」
blocks.en: Key Point: The "Limited Value" of Empty Tunnel Studies

blocks.zh: USP 罕見地直接說明某種研究「價值有限」（limited value）。對於連續隧道，空載研究的問題在於：
blocks.en: USP rarely states outright that a type of study has "limited value". For a continuous tunnel, the problem with an empty study is that:

blocks.zh: 空載時氣流模式與有載時完全不同
blocks.en: The airflow pattern when empty is completely different from that when loaded

blocks.zh: 玻璃容器本身會影響隧道內的熱傳特性
blocks.en: The glass containers themselves affect heat transfer characteristics inside the tunnel

blocks.zh: 因此空載資料無法代表實際生產條件
blocks.en: Therefore empty data cannot represent actual production conditions

blocks.zh: 隧道溫度研究必須在滿載條件下進行，這是與烘箱驗證的重要差異。在法規審查中，若僅提供空載隧道研究，可能被質疑驗證數據的代表性。
blocks.en: Tunnel temperature studies must be performed under fully loaded conditions; this is an important difference from oven validation. In regulatory review, providing only an empty tunnel study may call the representativeness of the validation data into question.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 冷點映射如同找建築最冷的房間
blocks.en: Analogy: Cold Spot Mapping Is Like Finding the Coldest Room in a Building

blocks.zh: 元件映射就像在寒冬中測試一棟建築物的保溫效果：你不能只測門廊的溫度就說整棟建築都夠暖，而是要找到最難加熱的那個角落（北面地下室）——這就是「冷點」。對乾熱去熱原而言，去熱原效果只取決於最冷點的 FH 值，因為如果最難加熱的地方都達標，其他地方必然也達標。
blocks.en: Component mapping is like testing the insulation of a building in midwinter: you cannot measure only the temperature of the porch and conclude that the whole building is warm enough; you have to find the corner that is hardest to heat (the north-facing basement). That is the "cold spot". For dry heat depyrogenation, the depyrogenation effect depends only on the FH value at the coldest point, because if the hardest place to heat meets the target, everywhere else must meet it too.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 烘箱負載映射關鍵原則
blocks.en: Key Concept: Key Principles of Oven Load Mapping

blocks.zh: 烘箱負載映射有兩個看似矛盾的原則需要理解：
blocks.en: Oven load mapping involves two seemingly contradictory principles that need to be understood:

blocks.zh: 滿載優於空載：更大的熱質量通常使溫度分佈更均勻（大量玻璃吸收和分散熱量）
blocks.en: A full load is better than an empty chamber: greater thermal mass usually makes temperature distribution more uniform (a large amount of glass absorbs and spreads the heat)

blocks.zh: 最大/最小負載均需驗證：因為最小負載可能造成更大的溫度變異（如前述）
blocks.en: Both maximum and minimum loads must be validated: because a minimal load can cause greater temperature variability (as described above)

blocks.zh: 因此實務上需要驗證兩個邊界條件：最大負載和最小負載，兩者都必須符合 FH 要求。
blocks.en: In practice, therefore, two boundary conditions must be validated: maximum load and minimum load. Both must meet the FH requirement.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 — 隧道負載映射感溫器配置要求
blocks.en: Formula and Calculation: Temperature Sensor Placement Requirements for Tunnel Load Mapping

blocks.zh:
隧道負載映射溫度感測器配置：

位置要求：
  - 前緣 (Leading edge)：玻璃進入加熱區的第一排
  - 中間 (Middle/Highest density)：密度最高區域
  - 尾緣 (Trailing edge)：玻璃離開加熱區的最後排

橫向要求：
  - 每段至少 NLT 5 個感測器（跨輸送帶寬度均勻分佈）

感測器接觸要求：
  - 必須直接接觸玻璃容器底部
  - 使用可隨動的拖曳型 (Trailing) 或無線 (Wireless) 感溫器

F_H 計算：
  - 從所有監測位置的溫度資料計算
  - 找出最低 F_H 位置 → 作為驗證確認研究的最壞情況
blocks.en:
Temperature sensor placement for tunnel load mapping:

Position requirements:
  - Leading edge: the first row of glass entering the heating zone
  - Middle/Highest density: the area of highest density
  - Trailing edge: the last row of glass leaving the heating zone

Lateral requirements:
  - At least NLT 5 sensors per position (evenly distributed across the conveyor belt width)

Sensor contact requirements:
  - Must be in direct contact with the bottom of the glass container
  - Use trailing or wireless temperature sensors that can travel with the load

F_H calculation:
  - Calculated from the temperature data at all monitored locations
  - Find the location with the lowest F_H → use as the worst case for the validation confirmation study

blocks.zh: 為什麼玻璃容器進入去熱原製程時通常是「濕的」？這對元件映射研究有何影響？若未以「濕玻璃」進行映射，驗證結論可能有何偏差？
blocks.en: Why do glass containers usually enter the depyrogenation process "wet"? How does this affect the component mapping study? If mapping is not performed with "wet glass", what bias might there be in the validation conclusion?

blocks.zh: 隧道負載映射為何必須在「前緣、中間、尾緣」三個位置都放置感溫器？每個位置各代表哪種最壞情況？
blocks.en: Why must temperature sensors be placed at all three positions (leading edge, middle, trailing edge) in tunnel load mapping? What worst case does each position represent?

blocks.zh: Confirmation of Depyrogenation 去熱原確認
blocks.en: Confirmation of Depyrogenation

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — NMT 0.1 EU 的由來
blocks.en: Key Concept: Origin of NMT 0.1 EU

blocks.zh: 可接受標準：NMT 0.1 EU/樣品（Not More Than 0.1 EU）
blocks.en: Acceptance criterion: NMT 0.1 EU/sample (Not More Than 0.1 EU)

blocks.zh: 這個數值來自於注射用藥品的安全限值邏輯：
blocks.en: This value comes from the safety limit logic for injectable drug products:

blocks.zh: FDA 規定靜脈注射藥品的內毒素限值通常為 5 EU/kg/hr
blocks.en: FDA generally sets the endotoxin limit for intravenous drug products at 5 EU/kg/hr

blocks.zh: 以 70 kg 體重的患者，每小時最大用量計算，容器的內毒素殘留應遠低於這個值
blocks.en: For a 70 kg patient, calculated at the maximum hourly dose, the endotoxin residue in a container should be far below this value

blocks.zh: 0.1 EU/容器是一個保守且實務可達的目標，確保即使最壞情況也對病患安全
blocks.en: 0.1 EU/container is a conservative and practically achievable target that ensures patient safety even in the worst case

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 確認研究在「減量條件」下執行
blocks.en: Key Point: The Confirmation Study Is Performed Under "Reduced" Conditions

blocks.zh: 確認研究的關鍵設計邏輯：在比常規生產更嚴苛（更低 FH）的條件下執行，仍能通過 NMT 0.1 EU 的標準。
blocks.en: The key design logic of the confirmation study: it is performed under conditions more severe than routine production (lower FH) and must still pass the NMT 0.1 EU criterion.

blocks.zh: 這種「縮短時間/降低溫度」的最壞情況設計，確保即使製程在驗證邊界的下限運作，去熱原效果仍然充分。通過最壞情況後，日常生產條件（F<sub>H</sub> 更高）自然被涵蓋在內。
blocks.en: This worst-case design of "shorter time / lower temperature" ensures that depyrogenation remains sufficient even if the process operates at the lower limit of the validated boundary. Once the worst case passes, routine production conditions (with higher F<sub>H</sub>) are naturally covered.

blocks.zh: 這也說明為什麼確認研究不是在「正常條件」下進行——那樣只能證明正常條件有效，不能證明邊界條件的安全性。
blocks.en: This also explains why the confirmation study is not performed under "normal conditions": that would only prove that normal conditions work, not that the boundary conditions are safe.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 最壞情況測試如同安全測試
blocks.en: Analogy: Worst-Case Testing Is Like Safety Testing

blocks.zh: 汽車安全碰撞測試不會只在最輕微的碰撞中測試，而是模擬最嚴苛的撞擊情境（如 64 km/h 正面碰撞）。若車輛在最壞條件下乘客仍安全，代表日常的輕微碰撞必然也安全。去熱原確認研究的邏輯完全相同：在最壞的 F<sub>H</sub> 條件下仍能通過 NMT 0.1 EU，日常生產的更高 F<sub>H</sub> 自然也通過。
blocks.en: Automobile crash safety tests are not run only on the mildest collisions; they simulate the most severe scenarios (such as a 64 km/h frontal crash). If occupants are still safe under the worst conditions, then everyday minor collisions must be safe too. The logic of the depyrogenation confirmation study is exactly the same: if the worst-case F<sub>H</sub> condition still passes NMT 0.1 EU, the higher F<sub>H</sub> of routine production passes naturally.

blocks.zh: 烘箱去熱原確認研究中，為何取樣位置要在「冷點附近」（NLT 10 個監測位置）？如果只取樣熱點附近，驗證結論會有何問題？
blocks.en: In an oven depyrogenation confirmation study, why should sampling locations be "near the cold spots" (NLT 10 monitoring locations)? What would be wrong with the validation conclusion if only locations near hot spots were sampled?

blocks.zh: 如果一批玻璃瓶的來料內毒素殘留量為 0.05 EU/瓶，而去熱原確認研究要求 NMT 0.1 EU，請問這代表需要多少對數降低量（log reduction）？這樣的需求合理嗎？
blocks.en: If the incoming endotoxin level on a batch of glass vials is 0.05 EU/vial and the depyrogenation confirmation study requires NMT 0.1 EU, how many log reductions does this imply? Is such a requirement reasonable?

blocks.zh: Routine Process Control 常規製程控制
blocks.en: Routine Process Control

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 維持驗證狀態的七大要素
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Seven Elements for Maintaining the Validated State

blocks.zh: USP 列出維持乾熱去熱原驗證狀態的七大必要實務：
blocks.en: USP lists seven essential practices for maintaining the validated state of dry heat depyrogenation:

blocks.zh: 校準 (Calibration)：溫度感測器定期校準，確保量測準確性
blocks.en: Calibration: calibrate temperature sensors periodically to ensure measurement accuracy

blocks.zh: 物理量測 (Physical Measurements)：定期確認設備物理狀態（如 HEPA 完整性、氣流）
blocks.en: Physical measurements: periodically confirm the physical condition of the equipment (such as HEPA integrity and airflow)

blocks.zh: 定期來料內毒素評估 (Periodic Endotoxin Assessment)：確認輸入端內毒素殘留在已知範圍內
blocks.en: Periodic endotoxin assessment of incoming items: confirm that endotoxin on incoming items remains within the known range

blocks.zh: 持續製程控制 (Ongoing Process Control)：每批次確認溫度與時間參數
blocks.en: Ongoing process control: confirm the temperature and time parameters for every batch

blocks.zh: 變更管控 (Change Control)：任何設備或製程變更都需評估影響
blocks.en: Change control: any equipment or process change must be assessed for impact

blocks.zh: 預防性維護 (Preventive Maintenance)：依計畫維護設備，防範失效
blocks.en: Preventive maintenance: maintain equipment according to plan to prevent failure

blocks.zh: 定期重新評估與訓練 (Periodic Reassessment and Training)：確保人員能力與製程知識持續更新
blocks.en: Periodic reassessment and training: ensure that personnel competence and process knowledge are kept up to date

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 維持驗證狀態如同飛機適航維護
blocks.en: Analogy: Maintaining the Validated State Is Like Aircraft Airworthiness Maintenance

blocks.zh: 一架飛機通過初次適航認證後，不代表永遠可以安全飛行。每次飛行前需要例行檢查（持續製程控制），定期需要大檢修（定期重新評估），使用授權零件更換（變更管控），飛行員需要定期複訓（訓練）。去熱原製程的「維持驗證狀態」邏輯完全相同——初始驗證只是取得「適航證書」，之後的持續控制才能確保每批次「安全起飛」。
blocks.en: An aircraft that has passed its initial airworthiness certification is not safe to fly forever. Routine checks are needed before every flight (ongoing process control), major overhauls at regular intervals (periodic reassessment), authorized parts for replacements (change control), and pilots need periodic recurrent training (training). The logic of "maintaining the validated state" for a depyrogenation process is exactly the same: initial validation only earns the "airworthiness certificate", and it is the ongoing control afterwards that ensures every batch "takes off safely".

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 溫度與時間的替代確認邏輯
blocks.en: Key Point: The Alternative Confirmation Logic of Temperature and Time

blocks.zh: USP 指出：在無法直接計算 FH 的情況下，確認溫度與時間條件均已達到，就等同確認製程在驗證受控狀態下運作。
blocks.en: USP points out that where FH cannot be calculated directly, confirming that both the temperature and time conditions have been achieved is equivalent to confirming that the process is operating in the validated, controlled state.

blocks.zh: 這是很重要的實務邏輯：大多數商業生產中，每批次並不實際計算 F<sub>H</sub> 值，而是透過批次記錄確認：
blocks.en: This is an important practical principle: in most commercial production, the F<sub>H</sub> value is not actually calculated for each batch; instead the batch record is used to confirm that:

blocks.zh: 最低溫度 ≥ 驗證最低溫度設定值
blocks.en: Minimum temperature ≥ validated minimum temperature set point

blocks.zh: 保溫時間 ≥ 驗證最短保溫時間
blocks.en: Dwell time ≥ validated minimum dwell time

blocks.zh: 若兩個條件均滿足，根據 F<sub>H</sub> 數學模型，去熱原效果必然 ≥ 驗證時確認的最低效果。
blocks.en: If both conditions are met, then according to the F<sub>H</sub> mathematical model, the depyrogenation effect must be ≥ the minimum effect confirmed during validation.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — PDA TR3 的重要性
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Importance of PDA TR3

blocks.zh: Appendix 引用的 PDA Technical Report 3 (2013)「Validation of dry heat processes used for depyrogenation and sterilization」是業界最重要的乾熱去熱原指引文件之一。
blocks.en: PDA Technical Report 3 (2013), "Validation of dry heat processes used for depyrogenation and sterilization", cited in the Appendix, is one of the most important industry guidance documents on dry heat depyrogenation.

blocks.zh: USP 〈1228.1〉 與 PDA TR3 互相補充：
blocks.en: USP <1228.1> and PDA TR3 complement each other:

blocks.zh: USP 提供法定要求（藥典標準）
blocks.en: USP provides the compendial (legally recognized) requirements

blocks.zh: PDA TR3 提供更詳細的技術實施指引和最佳實務
blocks.en: PDA TR3 provides more detailed technical implementation guidance and best practices

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 驗證計畫的設計中，同時參考兩份文件是標準做法。
blocks.en: Referring to both documents is standard practice when designing a CDMO validation program.

blocks.zh: 某乾熱隧道的驗證溫度設定為 320°C，保溫時間 12 分鐘。一批生產記錄顯示最低溫度 322°C，保溫時間 13 分鐘。這批次的去熱原狀態是否可接受？請用 F<sub>H</sub> 概念解釋。
blocks.en: The validation temperature for a dry heat tunnel is set at 320°C with a dwell time of 12 minutes. A production record shows a minimum temperature of 322°C and a dwell time of 13 minutes. Is the depyrogenation status of this batch acceptable? Explain using the F<sub>H</sub> concept.

blocks.zh: 「定期來料內毒素評估」是七大要素之一，為什麼需要持續監控原料的內毒素輸入？如果來料內毒素突然顯著上升，對驗證狀態有何影響？
blocks.en: "Periodic endotoxin assessment of incoming items" is one of the seven elements. Why is it necessary to continuously monitor the endotoxin input of incoming materials? If endotoxin on incoming items suddenly rises significantly, how does this affect the validated state?

blocks.zh: 某工廠的去熱原烘箱因加熱元件老化，修復後更換了新元件。請說明需要執行哪些後續驗證活動，依據 USP 常規製程控制原則。
blocks.en: A plant's depyrogenation oven had its heating element replaced with a new one after repair because of aging. Describe the follow-up validation activities that need to be performed, according to the USP routine process control principles.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 驗證主計畫整合
blocks.en: Practical Application: Integration into the CDMO Validation Master Plan

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，去熱原驗證應整合到驗證主計畫 (Validation Master Plan, VMP) 中，確保：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, depyrogenation validation should be integrated into the Validation Master Plan (VMP) to ensure:

blocks.zh: 跨產品一致性：相同設備用於不同客戶產品時，驗證方法論一致
blocks.en: Cross-product consistency: when the same equipment is used for different clients' products, the validation methodology is consistent

blocks.zh: 共用設備管理：同一台烘箱/隧道用於多個產品的驗證範圍清晰界定
blocks.en: Shared equipment management: the validation scope is clearly defined when the same oven/tunnel is used for multiple products

blocks.zh: 年度回顧：定期審查 FH 趨勢、異常事件和校準歷史，評估製程持續適宜性
blocks.en: Annual review: periodically review FH trends, abnormal events and calibration history to assess the continued suitability of the process

blocks.zh: 客戶審計準備：驗證文件完整、可追溯，隨時可應對客戶或法規查核
blocks.en: Client audit readiness: validation documentation is complete and traceable, ready at any time for client or regulatory inspection

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 設備確效 (EQ) 包含 IQ/OQ 或整合的 I/OQ，為預防性維護和變更管控建立基準；驗證前就應了解來料內毒素殘留量。
blocks.en: Equipment qualification (EQ) includes IQ/OQ or a combined I/OQ and establishes the baseline for preventive maintenance and change control; the endotoxin level on incoming items should be understood before validation.

blocks.zh: 溫度分佈研究需注意：隧道空載研究價值有限，應只在滿載條件下進行；玻璃應以「濕」狀態進行元件映射。
blocks.en: For temperature distribution studies, note that an empty tunnel study has limited value and should be performed only under fully loaded conditions; component mapping should be performed with glass in the "wet" state.

blocks.zh: 去熱原確認研究在最壞情況（縮短時間/降低溫度）下執行，可接受標準為 NMT 0.1 EU/樣品，烘箱要求 NLT 10 個監測位置各取 5 個樣品。
blocks.en: The depyrogenation confirmation study is performed under worst-case conditions (shorter time / lower temperature), with an acceptance criterion of NMT 0.1 EU/sample; for ovens, NLT 10 monitoring locations with 5 samples each are required.

blocks.zh: 維持驗證狀態需七大要素：校準、物理量測、定期來料內毒素評估、持續製程控制、變更管控、預防性維護、定期重新評估與訓練。
blocks.en: Maintaining the validated state requires seven elements: calibration, physical measurements, periodic endotoxin assessment of incoming items, ongoing process control, change control, preventive maintenance, and periodic reassessment and training.
